title: autobott APT package entry
description: A package reference under packages/. Names one package at ONE version and references that version's .deb artifacts; the publish CI downloads and verifies them. Usually one file per app (packages/<name>.json), but the filename is free and several files MAY name the same package — that is how an app ships a different version to different suites (packages/klassy.trixie.json, packages/klassy.sid.json). All files are merged at publish time; the only uniqueness rule, enforced by hydrate rather than here, is that no two artifacts across all of packages/ and debs/ claim the same (package, release, arch).

name.description: Debian package name (must match the .deb's Package field).

version.description: Package version, including any packaging revision and suite suffix (must match the .deb's Version field exactly, e.g. "6.7.2-1~sid"). Every artifact in this file must carry it; register a differing version into its own file.

release.description: Target Debian release codename (must be one of conf/dists.conf DISTS), or "any" for a release-agnostic build placed into every configured suite. Membership is checked at hydrate time against the repo config, not here, so DISTS stays editable without touching this schema.

arch.description: Debian architecture (must match the .deb's Architecture and be one of conf/dists.conf ARCHES). "all" is arch-independent and indexed under every architecture.

url.description: Direct HTTPS download URL of the .deb (e.g. a GitHub Release asset).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the .deb; verified after download.
